violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: (1) UNSALTED BUTTER (48F) AND STRAWBERRY BUTTER (50F) WERE STORED IN TRUE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER FOR 4 HOURS AND 45 MINUTES; (2) CHICKPEAS (44F), MARINARA SAUCE (44F), CHICKEN SALAD (45F) PASTA PENNE (45F), HEAVY WHIPPING CREAM (44F), AND HALF-HALF (44F) WERE STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT; (3). TUNA SALAD (46F), TUNA SALAD (47F), AND SLICED TURKEY (45F) WERE STORED IN 3-DOOR PREP COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: HALF-HALF.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS EDUCATED THE PIC.

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): HALF-HALF.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS AND PIC ESTABLISHED THE TPHC.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED A FOOD EMPLOYEE DIDN’T WASH HANDS AFTER HANDLING TRASH AND BEFORE COLLECTING CLEAN PLATES AND UTENSILS FROM DISHWASHER.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS PROMPTED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HAND SINK.

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: CFM WAS NOT ABLE TO PRESENT A PARASITE DESTRUCTION STATEMENT FOR SALMON.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PLEASE OBTAIN A PARASITE DESTRUCTION STATEMENT AND FORWARD THE STATEMENT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
